'''Skip 8''' was an inhabited [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited Skip 8 once during their [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] years.
